turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Is it weird to play board games on your own?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Not at all. Solo gaming is really popular, and lots of games come with a one player mode built in.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How does that even work with no opponent?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Usually the game plays against you with a deck of cards or simple rules, or you're trying to beat your own best score.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: my friends are never free when I am.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then solo games are perfect for you. Puzzly ones where you build something, like a garden or a city, feel calm after a long shift.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Calm sounds good. My job is not calm.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then avoid the ones with timers. Look for games that say solo mode in the description, and read reviews from people who mostly play alone.
